# Financial Advisor Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Financial Advisor Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 22 captured build checkpoints; 6 skills; 2 knowledge files; 7 acceptance checks; 6 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available; keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review uploaded advisory files, the proposed banking connections and the intended channel; document blocked paths rather than bypassing them. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always authentication trigger; record who may build, test and use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for Dynamics 365, the identification workflow, portfolio and research services, Microsoft 365 and Teams, each with a least-privilege reference. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare banker, director, advisor, compliance and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; makers use Draft Preview. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio in the browser and the reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and a supported PAC CLI. | Customer or partner |
| Regulated decision ownership | Have the business owner name the licensed-advisor, compliance, identity, consent and trading approvers before real client data replaces the snapshot. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Branch advisory business owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Branch-to-advisor handoffs, identity-check steps and repeated customer information by request type Establish where customers repeat information and bankers lack context before attributing a change to the agent.

Fill your baseline record:

| Request type | Measurement period | Handoffs | Identity-check status | Information re-requested | Receiving role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Branch advisory business owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Branch advisory business owner | Approve scope, routing and escalation; confirm the reviewer each response names for unverified items. |
| Licensed advisors and compliance reviewers | Own advice, suitability, recommendation approval and compliance decisions that the agent must not make. |
| Identity and trading authorities | Complete identity verification in the approved workflow and authorize any order, transfer or money movement. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and six skills; remove web search, confirm the model and record Draft state. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before any banking connection is approved. |
| Banking connection owners | Approve Dynamics 365, identification, portfolio, Microsoft 365 and Teams access through least-privilege connection references. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check FAC-01 through FAC-06, their forbidden phrases and the boundary tests on the current Draft; reject partial-ingestion answers. |
| Operations owner | Own production monitoring, support and configuration recovery; route advice and approval requests to licensed reviewers. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures for branch advisory have named agreement.
- [ ] The business owner records current handoffs, identity-check steps and repeated customer information before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/financial-advisor-copilot/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and confirm blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The approved environment and publisher prefix for the branch-advisory build are recorded before a build lane is chosen.
- [ ] The customer approves the sign-in requirement, audience and least-privilege scopes for client financial data before any connection is bound.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/financial-advisor-copilot/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/financial-advisor-copilot/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/financial-advisor-copilot/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/financial-advisor-copilot/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Financial Advisor Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_financial-advisor-copilot-controls-and-review.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_financial-advisor-copilot-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: aibast_advisor-handoff_06
9. Add skill: aibast_client-review_02
10. Add skill: aibast_compliance-check_05
11. Add skill: aibast_portfolio-summary_03
12. Add skill: aibast_recommendation-engine_04
13. Add skill: aibast_service-intake_01
14. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
15. Open a fresh Preview conversation
16. Pass FAC-01: Branch Banker
17. Pass FAC-02: Advisory Director
18. Pass FAC-03: Financial Advisor
19. Pass FAC-04: Financial Advisor
20. Pass FAC-05: Compliance Officer
21. Pass FAC-06: Branch Banker
22. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: FAC-01, FAC-02, FAC-03, FAC-04, FAC-05, FAC-06. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, environment, model, inventory, cases and Draft state.
- [ ] If the portable lane is chosen, the smoke test calls `FinancialAdvisorCopilotAgent` and returns its required markers.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, six skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent.
- [ ] Each unchanged locked prompt passes once in its own fresh Preview conversation on the owned Draft.
- [ ] The deterministic validator decides each case; an annotated visual checkpoint does not replace it.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before any client financial information is shown. Request only the scopes that approved customer, portfolio and identification sources need. Restrict the audience and verify access with authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Dynamics 365 banking or CRM context

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Banking connection owners

1. **Bind Dynamics 365 banking or CRM context — read:** Bind scoped read-only customer and case lookups through an approved connector.

2. **Identity for Dynamics 365 banking or CRM context:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Dynamics 365 banking or CRM context:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Dynamics 365 banking or CRM context:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 4](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Produce a draft handoff only; no case transfer or client contact occurs. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Reject the identifier or clarify it; never disclose or substitute another client's record.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Approved customer-identification workflow

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Banking connection owners

1. **Bind Approved customer-identification workflow — read:** Expose read-only verification status; keep verification in the approved workflow.

2. **Identity for Approved customer-identification workflow:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved customer-identification workflow:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved customer-identification workflow:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 1](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Verify nothing and open nothing; show the pending authorized check and the approved identification route. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim that a lookup, verification or handoff succeeded.

### Step 3-3. Integrate Approved portfolio and research services

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Banking connection owners

1. **Bind Approved portfolio and research services — read:** Bind approved read-only portfolio data through a connector or MCP tool.

2. **Identity for Approved portfolio and research services:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved portfolio and research services:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved portfolio and research services:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 3](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Create no order or transaction; the discussion candidates are not recommendations. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim that a lookup, verification or handoff succeeded.

### Step 3-4. Integrate Microsoft 365

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Banking connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft 365 — read-write:** Ground on approved Microsoft 365 content first; gate any document or message write.

2. **Identity for Microsoft 365:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft 365:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft 365:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 4](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Produce a draft handoff only; no case transfer or client contact occurs. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim that a lookup, verification or handoff succeeded.

### Step 3-5. Integrate Microsoft Teams handoffs

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Banking connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams handoffs — write:** Gate any Teams handoff flow behind banker and advisor approval (preview).

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams handoffs:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams handoffs:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams handoffs:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 4](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Produce a draft handoff only; no case transfer or client contact occurs. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim that a lookup, verification or handoff succeeded.

### Step 3-6. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Banking connection owners

Create only approved least-privilege tools; keep identity, transfer and order actions behind explicit approval gates.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Only approved least-privilege tools are bound, and consequential actions keep explicit approval gates.
- [ ] No lookup, handoff or record change is reported unless an approved production tool returns success evidence.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Test the approved deployment with banking and denied identities; a maker's working connection does not prove other users' access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The business owner sets customer-data acceptance measures; synthetic assets, drift and flags are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations name the tested version and user profile; General quality scoring does not replace exact advisory assertions.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked advisory corpus | All six cases, FAC-01 through FAC-06, return every required marker and no forbidden phrase. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, six skills and the reviewed model; web search removed and no tools. |
| Regulated authority boundary | Any identity verification, advice, suitability decision, approval, account action, transfer, outreach, order or transaction claim is no-go. |
| Publish safety gate | Synthetic labels, human review and no-advice, no-approval, no-transaction behavior are validated before publish. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Reusable captures show a positive deterministic anchor and no blocker; reshoot-required captures stay withheld. |
| Release state | Both validated agents remain Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Branch advisory business owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Branch advisory business owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation from the approval owner.
- [ ] The approved banking audience and supported channels are tested before publication is confirmed.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review failed sessions, wrong-client answers, connection errors and credit usage in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Recovery is rehearsed with a restore path supported for the advisory environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, knowledge use, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.
